strongs_1890.strongs_def: a tiara, i.e. official turban (of a king or high priest)

occurrences.bsb: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash. They are to make these holy garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that they may serve Me as priests.
occurrences.kjv: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

occurrences.bsb: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.

occurrences.bsb: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.

occurrences.bsb: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.

occurrences.bsb: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,
occurrences.kjv: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

occurrences.bsb: Then they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
occurrences.kjv: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the Lord commanded Moses.

occurrences.bsb: Moses also put the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the holy diadem, on the front of the turban, as the LORD had commanded him.
occurrences.kjv: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the Lord commanded Moses.

occurrences.bsb: He is to wear the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments. He must tie a linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are holy garments, and he must bathe himself with water before he wears them.
occurrences.kjv: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.

occurrences.bsb: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Remove the turban, and take off the crown. Things will not remain as they are: Exalt the lowly and bring low the exalted.
occurrences.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.
